name: Delayering & Imaging
description: Controlled removal of IC metal and dielectric layers to expose underlying circuit structures, followed by high-resolution imaging for layout reconstruction. Covers chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP), wet and dry etching of metal/dielectric layers, optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and image stitching for full-die imaging. Essential for circuit extraction, Trojan detection, and counterfeit analysis.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to IC delayering or imaging

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands IC fabrication layer stack and delayering objectives
evidence: Can describe a typical IC metal layer stack (substrate, poly, metal 1-N, passivation)
Understands the purpose of delayering for circuit extraction and Trojan detection
Aware of optical and electron microscopy modalities used in IC imaging

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs delayering and imaging on sample ICs under supervision
evidence: Removes passivation and top metal layers using appropriate wet or dry etch chemistry
Operates optical microscope to capture layer images at appropriate magnification
Performs basic SEM imaging of delayered IC surfaces with guidance
Documents layer-by-layer imaging with proper indexing and metadata

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently delayers ICs and produces full-die image sets for analysis
evidence: Controls etch depth to remove individual metal layers without damaging underlying structures
Produces full-die stitched images at each metal layer with alignment markers
Identifies standard cell structures, memory arrays, and custom logic in layer images
Completed delayering and imaging for 3+ different IC fabrication processes independently

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles advanced process nodes; performs circuit extraction; develops imaging procedures
evidence: Delayers advanced process nodes (sub-28nm) with copper interconnect and low-k dielectrics
Performs circuit extraction from layer images to reconstruct gate-level netlists
Develops etch recipes and process parameters for new fabrication technologies
Mentors team on delayering technique, etch endpoint detection, and imaging quality

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on IC delayering and imaging; defines methodology; specifies equipment
evidence: Defines the lab's delayering methodology for multiple fabrication process families
Evaluates and specifies SEM, FIB-SEM, and optical imaging equipment for the lab
Published research on IC reverse engineering or hardware Trojan detection methodologies
Provides expert consultation on design-for-trust and anti-reverse-engineering techniques

assessment_methods.description: Delayer a prepared IC sample through multiple metal layers, produce stitched images at each layer, and identify key circuit structures
Review delayering image sets for layer completeness, image quality, alignment accuracy, and documentation
